parts.title: Listening Passage 1
parts.transcriptHtml:
Mary: Hello, South City International Club. How can I help you?

Jim Hunter: Oh, good morning. I want to find out about joining the club.

Mary: Right. I can help you there. I’m the club secretary, and my name’s Mary.

Jim Hunter: Hi, Mary. My name’s Jim Hunter. Can you tell me about the events you have there?

Mary: Sure. There are several events here. Let me give you some details. First of all, we have a library. You can use all the facilities there, and opening times are from 11AM to 6PM.

Jim Hunter: Thank you.

Mary: Just to note, there’s a deposit of $15 for using the library, which is returnable, of course, as long as there’s no damage.

Jim Hunter: That sounds fine. What else do you have?

Mary: Well, we also have an ice skating center, which is next to a telephone booth. The admission fee is $3. It’s only open on Sundays. Also, we have a special offer for new members. If you come to the center with a guest, then the guest can experience one class for free.

Jim Hunter: That is really a big attraction for me. I remember walking past there yesterday. I saw a poster about swimming. Do you have any swimming classes?

Mary: Yes. That is a new class. It starts on the October 16.

Jim Hunter: Right. Is it very expensive?

Mary: Well, the joining fee is only $1. Oh, no. I’m sorry. It’s recently gone up by $2. So it’s now $3 for each person. And we don’t provide any swimming suits here, so you need to bring your own.

Jim Hunter: I see. What about dance lessons? You mentioned that you have classes once a week.

Mary: Yes. The dance classes are very popular here. It’s a little expensive. The joining fee is $5, but that includes free drinks. We open all day, and you can bring your own water and food.

Jim Hunter: Well, it’s still more expensive than I thought. I’m a student here, and I’m only here for six months.

Mary: Ah, then we offer you a great way to learn about Britain. We usually visit the Grand Hotel, a historical site, but this time, we are going to the local museum. The joining fee is $3. It is open between 10:30AM and 03:30PM during weekdays, and on weekends, it’s half an hour earlier.

Jim Hunter: That should be alright. I could come in my free periods.

Jim Hunter: By the way, I’m quite interested in tennis. I enjoy playing with my friends after work. Do you have tennis events I could join?

Mary: No. I’m afraid we don’t. Perhaps you are thinking about North City Centre. They’ve got a lot of events we don’t have and vice versa. But we organize events such as movie watching as long as there are over 30 viewers, and we have a lecture every four weeks.

Jim Hunter: Do you have any yoga classes?

Mary: Yes. We do have some yoga lessons, but the timetable is still in discussion. However, we arrange a Saturday excursion every month. You can come and check it out.

Jim Hunter: Great. I heard there would be other outdoor activities like a tour or something.

Mary: Yes. That’s right. We will offer a night city tour if you are interested. And as well as that, there’s a cultural evening event once a month.

Jim Hunter: That sounds good, but it is a pity that there’s no tennis at your club.

Mary: I will pass on your feedback to management. So if you would like to join in the club, you need to fill out a form and pay a $108 if you are over 19 and $95 if you are under. Both will need to be submitted to the club office. They will help you apply for the membership card.

Jim Hunter: Okay. Thanks for that information. I think I have all I need for now.

Mary: Thank you for calling South City International Club. Bye.

Event/Venue Time/Dates Fees Notes
Library Example: From 11:00 am to 6 pm Deposit: $______ Return the deposit there is no damage
______ centre Open on ______ $3 Bring one guest for free
Swimming Starts on ______ $______ Bring your own swimming suit
Dance class Open all day $5 (______ included) Bring enough water and food
______ Open between 10:30 am and 3:30 pm (weekdays) $3 Replacement for the visit to Grand hotel
